svg.text: Square-cut end, fit tight (gap 0-1). Weld ALL
ROUND: 3 fillet where the rail meets the post
face (shown), flare seam where the faces run
flush (det. B). Tack 2 per joint first.
Section on the rail centreline. The tube corner
radii leave a flare groove where faces run
flush: fill it in one pass. Faces marked * carry
panels, seals or pads: grind FLUSH (G).
Ledge top 18 below the rail top for the floor
and shelf, 12 for the partition: set it with an
offcut of the real ply. Stitch the UNDERSIDE
only - the top face is the ply seat.
D POST TOP CAP PL2 - ELEVATION
Top rails butt against the cap edge.
Cap flush with the tube faces all round: seal
weld the seam (outside corner) and grind flush
on all faces - the top panel and side panels
bear here. Weld after the box (step 7).
Outer edges flush with the frame: seal weld,
grind flush. Weld with the four pads clamped
to the flat table (coplanar). Castor bolts: plate
t + 8 max - must NOT reach the rail walls.
Drill before welding, deburr. Fit rivnuts
M6 x 20: skin + MLV 4.2, the rest into the
rivnut (6 min engaged). MLV punched D8 = gasket.
stick-out 8-10, push 10-15 deg - prove on a coupon
3 leg (2.1 throat) on 2 wall; tacks 6-8 long
undercut <= 0.5; no porosity on ground faces
grind zinc 25 each side, fume extraction
Outside W x D x H
Remove spatter; external * faces ground flush (80 grit), edges
broken. Blast Sa 2.5 (or chemical pretreat - tubes are perforated
by rivnut holes: coater to drain and dry them). Zinc-rich primer
+ polyester powder, satin black or RAL 7016. Mask the earth
point. Fit rivnuts after coating; bond frame to PE (M6, star
washer, bare metal) and the 19in strips with 4 mm2 jumpers.
Symbol under the line = arrow side.
SRA-16 Silent AC Rack - welded 30x30x2.0 frame
details NTS (proportional) @ A3 UNITS mm LAYOUT v1.2.0
FOR FABRICATION after hold point H1 (AC grille split M3)
